settings.custom_liquid:
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Add event listeners to quantity buttons and input
    const quantityInput = document.querySelector('input[name="quantity"]');
    const priceElements = document.querySelectorAll('.price');
    const priceElement = priceElements[0]; // First price element
    const quantityButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.quantity__button');
    
    if (quantityInput && priceElement) {
      const basePrice = {{ product.price }};
      
      // Update price on input change
      quantityInput.addEventListener('change', updateBundlePrice);
      quantityInput.addEventListener('input', updateBundlePrice);
      
      // Update price when quantity buttons are clicked
      if (quantityButtons) {
        quantityButtons.forEach(button => {
          button.addEventListener('click', function() {
            // Use setTimeout to ensure quantity has been updated
            setTimeout(updateBundlePrice, 10);
          });
        });
      }
      
      // Initial price update
      updateBundlePrice();
      
      function updateBundlePrice() {
        const quantity = parseInt(quantityInput.value, 10) || 1;
        const totalPrice = basePrice * quantity;
        
        // Find the price amount element inside the price container
        const priceAmountElement = priceElement.querySelector('.price__regular .price-item');
        if (priceAmountElement) {
          // Add highlight class
          priceAmountElement.classList.add('price-updating');
          
          // Update the price
          priceAmountElement.textContent = Shopify.formatMoney(totalPrice, {{ shop.money_format | json }});
          
          // Remove highlight class after animation
          setTimeout(() => {
            priceAmountElement.classList.remove('price-updating');
          }, 300);
        }
      }
    }
  });
</script>

<style>
  @keyframes price-update {
    0% { transform: scale(1); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.06); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
  }
  
  .price-updating {
    animation: price-update 0.3s ease-in-out;
  }
</style>
